title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta36

## Navimower Schedule custom order

- Adds **Automatic order** and **Custom order** modes while preserving the existing proven-zone allowlist.
- Custom order is an ordered queue and may contain the same zone multiple times at arbitrary positions.
- Each custom queue occurrence has its own slot identity, so duplicate zones are completed independently.
- Schedule status exposes order mode, slot-aware queue, active slot and completed slots for Map Card visualization.
- Continuous mode starts a new round only after every custom queue slot is completed.
